title: The Big Trip
setting: Various travel locations including an airport and a hotel.

characters.name: Leo
characters.look: a young man with short brown hair and a blue backpack

characters.name: Mia
characters.look: a young woman with long black hair and a yellow sun hat

sentences.en: Leo and Mia arrive at the station.
sentences.zh: 里奥和米娅到达了车站。
sentences.scene_prompt: Leo, a young man with short brown hair and a blue backpack, and Mia, a young woman with long black hair and a yellow sun hat, stand at a busy train station.

sentences.en: They start their holiday in France.
sentences.zh: 他们在法国开始了他们的假期。
sentences.scene_prompt: Leo and Mia stand in front of a beautiful building in France with their bags.

sentences.en: A big aeroplane flies to the north.
sentences.scene_prompt: A large white aeroplane flies high in the blue sky above the clouds.

sentences.en: The plane travels far to Rome.
sentences.scene_prompt: Leo and Mia look out of an aeroplane window at the clouds below.

sentences.en: They see an Australian boat in Africa.
sentences.zh: 他们在非洲看到一艘澳大利亚的船。
sentences.scene_prompt: A large boat with an Australian flag sails on the ocean near the African coast.

sentences.en: They stay at a nice hotel.
sentences.zh: 他们住在一间很棒的酒店里。
sentences.scene_prompt: Leo and Mia walk into the lobby of a beautiful, sunny hotel.

sentences.en: Mia writes a postcard from the east.
sentences.zh: 米娅从东方写了一张明信片。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia, wearing a yellow sun hat, sits at a table and writes on a postcard.
